name: Nimue
source:
A man awoke by the lake with no name, no past, nothing.

Rescued by Seren, a pilgrim traveling to the shrine of Saint Nimue, he slowly learns about this world. The "Saint" worshipped in this land. The "evil sorcerer" she sealed away long ago.

Then his memories begin to return.

Who he truly was. Who the woman called "Saint" truly was. And why he was at the bottom of that lake.

When you learn everything, you will be forced to choose.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4240010/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个人在湖边醒来，没有名字，没有过去，什么也没有。

被前往圣尼缪神社的朝圣者瑟伦所救，他慢慢了解了这个世界。“圣人”在这片土地上崇拜。早就被她封印的“邪恶巫师”。

然后他的记忆开始恢复。

他到底是谁。那个被称为“圣人”的女人到底是谁。以及为什么他会在那个湖的底部。

当你学会一切时，你将被迫做出选择。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4240010/]Steam[/url]]
